race.comment: LISZTOMANIA (5) ran fourth here last year after drawing out. Looks to be going even better this time in when four weeks between runs with a slashing win over 1200m at Rosehill in BM94 class. Fresh again and makes plenty of appeal from the draw. CHAINS OF LOVE (12) untapped mare resuming. Jumped in grade with an eye catching third in the LR Creswick Stakes at Flemington over 1200m last July. Primed with the three searching trials and gets the services of Zac Lloyd. Top three player. LORD REMLAP (9) lightly raced gelding with excellent credentials. Far from disgraced second up with the 60kg when a solid third over 1200m in a BM72 at Rosehill. Blinkers go on and will be charging late. CONSIDERED (8) raced without luck in her two runs back and assess on her good Military Rose win over 1200m at the Gold Coast last March. Conditions suit from the good gate. Each way. CHIDIAC (2) ran third here last year and worth noting she's undefeated in three first up runs. The chances don't end there.
